name: ISG 5502
title: Genetic Counseling Fieldwork Rotation II - Spring First Year
description: The second of six experiential supervised fieldwork placements applying genetic counseling theory from the classroom to practical clinical and non-clinical professional settings to support the development of genetic counseling practice-based competencies.
requirement_description: Open to graduate genetic counseling professional science master's students who have completed the first semester of the program. Corequisite: ISG 5501.
